edges.reason: msg.sender selects the address whose playerVault balance is drained in withdraw.
msg.sender becomes the new spud holder and receives bonuses in GetSpud.
msg.sender's spudcoin balance is spent and the payout is transferred to it.
msg.sender's spudcoin balance is spent when buying Rotator slots.
msg.sender's vanity string is written in changevanity.
Miner-influenced block.number/blockhash drives the win/lose outcome in returntrueifcurrentplayerwinsround.
block.number and blockhash(refblocknr) determine round advancement and jackpot payout in GetSpud.
MN parameter is credited spudcoins inside GetSpud.
van string is stored in the Vanity mapping.
masternode parameter is used as the P3D buy recipient.
amount parameter sizes the SpudPot payout in SpudToDivs.
amount parameter controls the Rotator slot loop in SpudToRotator.
MN parameter is written into Rotator slots.
amount parameter scales the computed payout in getthismuchethforyourspud.
sender local is used as the new spud holder in GetSpud.
blocknr local is written into Spudgame state in GetSpud.
curround local indexes Spudgame and selects the round to advance.
refblocknr local feeds the RNG and the timeout comparison.
RNGresult local branches the jackpot payout logic in GetSpud.
base local is the ETH amount forwarded to the external p3dContract.buy call.
payouts local is the ETH amount transferred to the caller in SpudToDivs.
dividends local is realised by the external p3dContract.withdraw call.
counter local is the index written into the Rotator mapping.
loop counter i is added to nextspotnr in SpudToRotator.
withdraw performs the external ETH transfer to msg.sender.
GetSpud forwards ETH to the external P3D contract before finishing state updates.
GetSpud transfers the jackpot to the previous player before settling Pot.
GetSpud derives its outcome from blockhash, which is miner-manipulable.
SpudToDivs calls the external P3D withdraw before adjusting SpudPot and balances.
SpudToDivs calls SPASM_.disburse with ETH before updating SpudPot.
SpudToDivs transfers the payout to the caller at the end of the state changes.
changevanity forwards msg.value to the external P3D buy call.
The withdraw transfer settles the amount previously held in playerVault.
Pot is reduced only after the player transfer returns in GetSpud.
SpudPot is credited from the dividends left after the SPASM disbursement.
withdraw reads and zeroes playerVault[msg.sender].
GetSpud writes the new holder and blocknumber into Spudgame.
GetSpud credits playerVault when the same block is replayed.
GetSpud mints spudcoins to the caller and the MN.
GetSpud does an unchecked totalsupply += 2 increment outside SafeMath.
GetSpud adds msg.value to Pot and subtracts the jackpot share.
GetSpud increments round when the jackpot is won.
GetSpud resets RNGdeterminator to 6 on a win.
GetSpud reads a Rotator entry as the P3D buy beneficiary.
SpudToDivs adds dividends into and subtracts payouts from SpudPot.
SpudToDivs debits the caller's SpudCoin balance.
SpudToDivs reduces totalsupply by the burned amount.
SpudToRotator writes masternode addresses into the Rotator mapping.
SpudToRotator performs an unchecked nextspotnr += i update.
SpudToRotator debits the caller's SpudCoin balance.
SpudToRotator reduces totalsupply by the spent amount.
getthismuchethforyourspud quotes against the SpudPot balance.
getthismuchethforyourspud divides by totalsupply.
returntrueifcurrentplayerwinsround takes the modulo of RNGdeterminator on a blockhash.
returntrueifcurrentplayerwinsround reads Spudgame[round].blocknumber as entropy.
thismanyblockstillthspudholderwins reads the round blocknumber.
currentspudinfo reads the round blocknumber and player.
constructor seeds Spudgame[0] with player and blocknumber.
constructor sets RNGdeterminator to 6.
constructor seeds Rotator[0] with the raffle3d address.
constructor increments nextspotnr.
The external P3D buy can re-enter GetSpud before Pot, round and Spudgame are settled.
A malicious player receiving the jackpot can re-enter GetSpud while Pot is still high.
The receiver of withdraw() can re-enter the contract.
p3dContract.withdraw triggers ETH delivery (fallback) that can re-enter SpudToDivs.
SPASM_.disburse triggers the payable fallback, allowing re-entry into SpudToDivs.

normalization_plan.reason: MN is only a parameter of GetSpud and should be folded into its function node.
van is only a parameter of changevanity and should be folded into its function node.
masternode is only a parameter of changevanity and should be folded into its function node.
amount is only a parameter of SpudToDivs and should be folded into its function node.
amount is only a parameter of SpudToRotator and should be folded into its function node.
MN is only a parameter of SpudToRotator and should be folded into its function node.
amount is only a parameter of getthismuchethforyourspud and should be folded into its function node.
sender is a temporary cache of msg.sender inside GetSpud and should be folded into that function.
blocknr is a temporary block.number copy inside GetSpud and should be folded into that function.
curround is a temporary round copy inside GetSpud and should be folded into that function.
refblocknr is a temporary Spudgame lookup inside GetSpud and should be folded into that function.
RNGresult is a temporary computed outcome inside GetSpud and should be folded into that function.
base is the value forwarded to the external p3dContract.buy call and should merge into that unsafe operation.
payouts is the amount handed to the external transfer in SpudToDivs and should merge into that unsafe operation.
dividends is the balance realised through the external p3dContract.withdraw call and should merge into that unsafe operation.
counter is a loop-local index created by SpudToRotator and should be folded into its function node.
i is a loop-local counter created by SpudToRotator and should be folded into its function node.
